item.goo.goo_label.tooltip: Holds a canister or vat to %s goo
item.goo.smithing_template.exorite_upgra: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
goo.ability.yore.rewind.description: Rewind time for a mob, freezing it while held, then turning it into a baby, or into its spawn egg.
goo.ability.yore.expire.description: Kills the mob struck outright. Does not work on bosses.
goo.ability.yore.ancient.description: No damage can take you below half a heart.
goo.ability.blaze.broil.description: Hold to channel heat into things to cook them.
goo.ability.blaze.ignite.description: Ignite where it lands in flame.
goo.ability.blaze.kindle.description: Hearts become ash, and ember. Ember hearts shield your ash hearts, which reignite based on remaining embers.
goo.ability.blaze.melt.description: Melts natural stone blocks into lava.
goo.ability.blaze.flames.description: Hold to channel a stream of fire.
goo.ability.crystal.cloud.description: A dome of razor-sharp crystals floats in space, slicing up anything that moves inside it.
goo.ability.crystal.knives.description: Hold to gather a fan of glass knives, then let go to sling them at enemies.
goo.ability.crystal.glitter.description: Hold to detect nearby gemstone ores.
goo.ability.crystal.scales.description: Your hearts gain a crystal shell that blocks damage instead of reducing your life.
goo.ability.crystal.prism.description: Grow a prism where it lands. Prisms react with other goo types.
goo.ability.astral.gate.description: Ephemeral lunar/solar portal depending on time of day.
goo.ability.astral.meteo.description: Calls a meteor; requires open sky.
goo.ability.astral.scry.description: Hold to see the spaces around you.
goo.ability.deep.churn.description: Churns the column under where the blob lands, causing what was beneath to rise up, and what is above to sink down.
goo.ability.deep.convoke.description: A blob that summons an entity from the depths.
goo.ability.deep.dive.description: Moves you downward, to any caves below you, within a short distance.
goo.ability.ender.zone.description: Curse a mob with teleportitis, preventing it from reaching you.
goo.ability.ender.blink.description: Teleport short distances. Blink to a prism to make an Oculus.
goo.ability.ender.blink.cost_mechanics: Plus %s per block travelled and %s more through a wall; Oculus Blinks cost %s percent.
goo.ability.ender.end.description: A temporary portal, takes you to the End at will.
goo.ability.ender.shifter.description: Instead of taking damage you blink 8 blocks in the direction you're looking.
goo.ability.quantum.phase.description: You stand out of phase: only creatures on your side of phase can hit you or be hit by you, and mobs lose you as a target.
goo.ability.quantum.phase_shift.descript: Puts a struck mob out of phase, so it can hit and target only creatures on its own side of phase.
goo.ability.quantum.hole.description: Opens a hole three blocks across and three deep into the blocks it strikes; the blocks return after a while.
goo.ability.quantum.anchor.description: Makes a prism a quantum anchor that pairs with your next one; a player standing at either anchor is carried to its partner.
goo.ability.quantum.swap.description: Leaves a swap body where you stand; casting again trades places with it.
goo.ability.quantum.link.description: Links the next two mobs you strike: health lost or gained by one is mirrored to the other, and so are status effects.
goo.ability.frost.snap.description: Freezes a mob if susceptible, and deals cold damage.
goo.ability.frost.nova.description: Hold to prepare a frost nova; freezes and damages nearby mobs.
goo.ability.frost.cold.description: Hold to sustain a gust of cold wind, freezing mobs.
goo.ability.frost.orb.description: Launches a slow moving orb that freezes mobs and water or lava along its path. It releases a frost nova on impact or expiration.
goo.ability.frost.iceborn.description: Frozen hearts take damage before normal hearts, but are weak to physical damage. Makes you extremely endothermic.
goo.ability.glow.crystal.description: A ray of light places a flat glowing crystal where it strikes. Transforms prisms into skyward beam emitters.
goo.ability.glow.sunbeam.description: Hold to sustain a beam of light, damaging enemies. Prisms transform into light reflectors. Light reflectors refract the beam to hit multiple enemies, and channel their light level to all blocks between themselves and another reflector.
goo.ability.glow.lux.description: Gives night vision, and mobs you look at glow.
goo.ability.glow.radiant.description: Hold to rapidly flood the dark air around you with fading wisps of light.
goo.ability.hex.charm.description: Charms a mob: until you hurt it, it fights whatever targets you, and follows you around.
goo.ability.hex.enchant.description: Enchant a single book in your inventory with one enchantment at random. May create curses.
goo.ability.hex.fuse.description: Fuses two identical enchanted books you carry into one a level higher, without an anvil.
goo.ability.hex.lifetap.description: Food no longer regenerates your health, but damage you deal heals you for a portion of it.
goo.ability.hex.drain.description: Hold to drain the health of a wide cone of creatures in front of you.
goo.ability.jelly.heal.description: Channel a healing stream that heals you and every living thing in its cone.
goo.ability.jelly.gluttony.description: You can overheal and overeat: healing past full health becomes extra hearts and eating past full hunger is banked as overhunger, which refills your hunger as it drops.
goo.ability.jelly.reserve.description: Channel to drain health and hunger into reserve hearts and shanks behind your bars, at a loss; the reserve is spent before your real health and hunger.
goo.ability.jelly.feed.description: Feeds an animal. Nearby mobs are drawn to it, hostile mobs fight over it.
goo.ability.leaf.barkskin.description: Bark hearts shield your hearts, regrow over time and thorn melee attackers; you take grievous damage from fire and axes.
goo.ability.leaf.vines.description: Roots a struck mob in vines, stabbing it with thorns when it tries to move. Entangled mobs are weak to fire. Can use on the ground to set a trap.
goo.ability.leaf.bloom.description: Spawns plants by chance around where the blob strikes.
goo.ability.leaf.growth.description: Channel a breeze that grows the plants in its cone and speeds Barkskin's regrowth. It can infuse a prism with growth-inducing energy.
goo.ability.leaf.reap.description: Harvests every ripe crop around where the blob strikes; a crop that would drop a seed is replanted.
goo.ability.leaf.bio.description: Inflicts a toxin that drains a share of the mob's max health over its duration. Repeat hits raise its potency, up to two stacks, and refresh the duration.
goo.ability.metal.javelin.description: A blob that transmutes into a dart in flight, stabbing a mob for moderate damage.
goo.ability.metal.magnet.description: Hold to sense metallic ores nearby.
goo.ability.metal.spikes.description: Throws a spike trap that impales creatures near it. Lasts many spears before expiring.
goo.ability.nether.black_hole.descriptio: Creates a black hole that pulls everything into itself, including items, compressing what it destroys into a dense ball in the center.
goo.ability.nether.decay.description: Hold to spray a swarm of nether motes that gnaw away at anything they touch.
goo.ability.nether.undead.description: Nether hearts fill your missing hearts and regenerate rapidly. You count as undead: harming heals you, healing harms you, and you burn in sunlight.
goo.ability.pulse.extender.description: All other sustained self-effects pay no upkeep on every other tick.
goo.ability.pulse.pulser.description: Channel to rapidly toggle levers, buttons, doors, trapdoors and fence gates in your aim. Transforms a prism into a metronome that repeats the cadence of the last two signals it received.
goo.ability.pulse.zap.description: Ticks the redstone device it hits. When it hits a wall it sends a penetrating pulse through it. Turns prisms into wireless redstone relays, connecting them with a beam of light.
goo.ability.rock.bore.description: Channel a narrow stream that tunnels through mundane blocks in front of you and damages mobs inside the tunnel.
goo.ability.rock.flatten.description: Hold to lock it to the axis of a block face; blocks around will be destroyed to make surfaces level with the chosen face.
goo.ability.rock.petrify.description: Channel a fog that slowly turns mobs into stone statues and calcifies exposed blocks, transmuting them into more solid blocks.
goo.ability.rock.spire.description: Drag a rectangular area of stone from the ground, creating walls or other cuboid shapes at will.
goo.ability.rock.stoneskin.description: Stone hearts fill your missing hearts. They take less physical damage but are worth only half a heart against explosions and pickaxes; your health stops regenerating while active.
goo.ability.shroom.mycosis.description: Spray a cloud of spores in a direction. Infected mobs are poisoned, slowed and weakened, and burst into spores on death; nether wart and fungal buds grow.
goo.ability.shroom.colonize.description: Throw a blob of shroom goo that spreads the shroom network it lands on, or buds the ground there if it lands on none. Spores and infects mobs nearby.
goo.ability.shroom.fungal_shift.descript: While standing near a fungus, move to the fungus block you aim at.
goo.ability.shroom.sight.description: Fungal Shift reaches three times farther, and you can see fungus blocks through walls.
goo.ability.kinetic.grab.description: Lifts the mob or item you look at and holds it in front of you; look down to draw it closer, left click to throw it.
goo.ability.kinetic.telekinesis.descript: You reach blocks and entities from farther away.
goo.ability.typhoon.shulk.description: Inflict the mob with levitation, causing it to float.
goo.ability.typhoon.float.description: You fly: in midair, jump rises, sneak sinks, forward and back move you along your look, and left and right strafe. You fall slowly without fall damage and jump higher. Wearing elytra further improves your air control.
goo.ability.typhoon.pneuma.description: While held, rapidly refills your air and banks the overflow in a reserve shown above your air bubbles, spent before your air when you cannot breathe. Letting go holds your breath briefly before it starts to run out.
goo.ability.typhoon.gust.description: Channel a rushing wind that pushes mobs in its cone away along your aim.
goo.ability.typhoon.updraft.description: A blob placed in the world creates a column of air that carries entities upwards. Causes prisms to transmute into Floatstones.
goo.ability.unstable.buster.description: Your melee hits strike every living thing near the one you hit, and each block you break also breaks the blocks around it.
goo.ability.unstable.explode.description: Explode wherever the goo lands. Hold on the block face and drag to create a larger blast.
goo.ability.unstable.lurker.description: A proximity mine that explodes when something living gets near. It pulses brightly as it detects creatures, before it explodes.
goo.ability.unstable.unmake.description: Destabilizing waves dismantle the blocks in front of you, turning them back into goo, which you collect automatically.
goo.ability.unstable.unmake.cost_mechani: Burns unstable goo for each block dissolved: the price is slightly higher than it would cost to melt in a crucible.
goo.ability.weird.coat.description: A held stream of slime: the floors it hits turn bouncy, the lava in it cools to magma, and the mobs it hits deal no damage, only knockback.
goo.ability.void.erase.description: Removes the mob struck from the world. There is no reward for doing this.
goo.ability.void.pocket.description: Item storage. Holds void goo while items are inside.
goo.ability.void.pocket.cost_mechanics: Open freely, items reserve %s void per slot to store, returned when retrieved.
goo.pocket.title: Pocket
goo.ability.void.outsider.description: Hold to enter your dimension. The doorway takes you back. Hold inside to grow the floor.
goo.ability.void.outsider.cost_mechanics: 6 void to enter. Growing the floor costs void per block.
goo.ability.weird.bounce.description: Leaves a bouncy pad where the blob lands.
goo.ability.weird.slime.description: The blob turns into a small slime where it lands.
goo.ability.zoo.allure.description: The animal is driven to mate, if possible.
goo.ability.zoo.rally.description: Peaceful creatures around you fight your enemies, with more health and speed.
goo.ability.zoo.shape.description: Turns a slime into a random peaceful mob for the biome it's in.
goo.ability.zoo.spawn.description: Turns the slime struck into a random hostile mob for the biome it's in.
goo.ability.cost_mechanics.upkeep: Costs nothing to start, then %s a second until you invoke it again or run dry.
goo.ability.param.afterimage.life.descri: Ticks each silhouette of the afterimage takes to grow outward and fade.
goo.ability.param.ailment_overlay.durati: Ticks the ailment's overlay shows on the target.
goo.ability.param.airborn.air_speed.desc: Blocks per tick you fly at when moving forward, backward or sideways in midair.
goo.ability.param.airborn.air_steer.desc: Fraction from 0 to 1 of the way your flight turns toward your movement input each tick.
goo.ability.param.airborn.climb_speed.de: Blocks per tick you climb while holding jump or descend while sneaking.
goo.ability.param.airborn.fall_cap.descr: Fastest you can fall, in blocks per tick, with no fall damage.
goo.ability.param.airborn.glide_speed.de: Blocks per tick an elytra glide is drawn toward along your look.
goo.ability.param.airborn.glide_steer.de: Fraction from 0 to 1 of the way a slower elytra glide is drawn up to the glide speed each tick.
goo.ability.param.airborn.jump_boost.des: Fraction your jump strength grows by, so 0.5 makes it half again as strong.
goo.ability.param.arc.blocks_per_tick.de: Blocks per tick the thrown goo rolls in a straight line, which it does instead of arcing when a range is set and this is below 2.5.
goo.ability.param.arc.flecks.description: Flecks a fully charged release slings; a shorter charge slings fewer, at least one.
goo.ability.param.arc.max_ticks.descript: Ticks you hold the throw to charge it fully before releasing.
goo.ability.param.arc.range.description: Blocks the thrown goo rolls in a straight line, with no gravity, when its speed is below 2.5 blocks per tick.
goo.ability.param.arc.spread_degrees.des: Degrees, edge to edge, that a fully charged release fans its flecks across; an uncharged release fans half as wide.
goo.ability.param.arc.sweep_ticks.descri: Ticks between the first fleck of a charged release leaving your hand and the last.
goo.ability.param.arc.top_speed.descript: Fastest the throw flies along its arc, in blocks per tick, slowing it so the eye can follow; 0 keeps the goo type's own flight time.
goo.ability.param.arc.transform_at.descr: Fraction from 0 to 1 of the flight by which the blob has taken its traveling form.
goo.ability.param.area.angle.description: Degrees from a cone's center line to its edge in the area preview shown while you hold right click.
goo.ability.param.area.size.description: Blocks the area preview shown while you hold right click reaches: a sphere's radius, a cone's length or a column's height.
goo.ability.param.area.width.description: Blocks from a column's center to its side in the area preview shown while you hold right click.
goo.ability.param.astral_gate.lifetime.d: Ticks the gate and its partner in the lunar or solar dimension stand before turning back into the blocks they covered.
goo.ability.param.await_entity.radius.de: Blocks around the goo an entity must come within to set off what follows.
goo.ability.param.beam.blocks_per_tick.d: Blocks per tick the goo flies in a straight line toward where you aimed.
goo.ability.param.bloom.radius.descripti: Blocks from where the blob struck that a plant may spawn.
goo.ability.param.bloom.tries.descriptio: Random spots the blob tries for plants before it stops.
goo.ability.param.bore.count.description: Most blocks the bore breaks each tick you hold it.
goo.ability.param.branch.when.descriptio: Value checked when this point is reached; any nonzero result runs the first set of effects and zero runs the other.
goo.ability.param.broil.cook_ticks.descr: Ticks of heat a block under your crosshair takes to cook into its furnace result.
goo.ability.param.broil.damage.descripti: Fire damage each pulse deals to every living thing in the heat, in half-hearts.
goo.ability.param.broil.every.descriptio: Ticks of holding between each pulse of fire damage.
goo.ability.param.buster.radius.descript: Blocks from the struck mob within which each of your melee hits also strikes every living thing.
goo.ability.param.calcify.ticks.descript: Ticks a block must stand in the fog before it turns into the next block along its chain.
goo.ability.param.churn.depth.descriptio: Layers of blocks the churned column runs deep, one turned each tick.
goo.ability.param.coat.ticks.description: Ticks of stream a block's top takes to grow a slime coat.
goo.ability.param.colonize.radius.descri: Blocks the shroom network spreads out from where the blob lands on it.
Blocks around the black hole within which every breakable block is pulled into its hoard.
goo.ability.param.convoke.every.descript: Ticks between each attempt to call a mob from the chunk; 1 tries every tick.
goo.ability.param.cost.cost.description: Goo in mB that one use of the ability costs.
goo.ability.param.cost_per_block.cost_pe: Goo in mB added to the cost for each block the blink travels.
goo.ability.param.counter.add.descriptio: Amount added to a tally the target keeps between hits, which the ability reads back later.
goo.ability.param.counter.set.descriptio: Value the target's tally is reset to, which the ability reads back later.
goo.ability.param.court.chance.descripti: Percent chance, from 0 to 100, that an animal ready to breed falls in love each time the effect reaches it.
goo.ability.param.damage.amount.descript: Damage dealt to the target, in half-hearts.
goo.ability.param.damage.invulnerable_ti: Ticks the target stays immune to further damage after this hit.
goo.ability.param.degrade.ticks.descript: Ticks of swarm a block takes to decay into its worn-down block.
goo.ability.param.detect_ore.growth.desc: Blocks the sensing sphere grows outward each tick you hold it.
goo.ability.param.detect_ore.life.descri: Ticks each found vein of ore shows through walls.
goo.ability.param.detect_ore.radius.desc: Farthest the sensing sphere reaches, in blocks.
goo.ability.param.detonate_explosive.pow: Strength of the fiery explosion set off when the blob lands on an explosive ability block, on the scale where TNT is 4.
goo.ability.param.dive.radius.descriptio: Blocks from your feet a cave landing may lie.
goo.ability.param.end.lifetime.descripti: Ticks the End portal and its partner on the End's platform stand before turning back into the blocks they covered.
goo.ability.param.entities.radius.descri: Blocks around the spot within which every qualifying living thing is affected.
goo.ability.param.explode.power.descript: Strength of the explosion, on the scale where TNT is 4.
goo.ability.param.feed.fight_ticks.descr: Ticks hostile mobs that reach the laid feed together fight each other.
goo.ability.param.feed.radius.descriptio: Blocks out to which the feed laid on the ground draws animals and mobs.
goo.ability.param.field_effect.ambient_c: Chance from 0 to 1 each tick that the field plays its ambient effects while it still has charges.
goo.ability.param.field_effect.charges.d: Strikes the field can pay for before it closes, each strike spending one when its spend chance passes.
goo.ability.param.field_effect.contract_: Ticks the field takes to shrink away once its charges are spent, 0 for at once.
Ticks after a strike starts before the field can start the next one.
goo.ability.param.field_effect.expand_ti: Ticks the field takes to grow to its full radius when it opens, 0 for at once.
Tick period, worked out for each creature, on which a creature in the field can be struck, so 2 strikes it every second tick.
goo.ability.param.field_effect.radius.de: Blocks from the field's center within which creatures are struck.
goo.ability.param.field_effect.spend_cha: Chance from 0 to 1 that a strike uses up a charge, 1 to spend one on every strike.
goo.ability.param.field_effect.strike_ti: Ticks after a strike starts that it hits its target, 0 to hit at once.
Ticks a strike stays in flight before it ends.
goo.ability.param.flames.burn_seconds.de: Seconds each burn keeps the target on fire.
goo.ability.param.flames.damage.descript: Fire damage each burn deals, in half-hearts.
goo.ability.param.flames.every.descripti: Ticks of holding between each spray of burning flames.
goo.ability.param.float.amplifier.descri: Levitation amplifier, where 0 is Levitation I and each step up rises faster.
goo.ability.param.floors.radius.descript: Blocks from the landing spot within which every open floor is reached.
goo.ability.param.freeze.amount.descript: Half-hearts of frost the hit adds to a mob's frozen gauge, which fills at the mob's max health.
goo.ability.param.freeze.hold.descriptio: Ticks a full frozen gauge holds before it starts to thaw.
Flat damage in half-hearts a physical hit gains on a frozen mob, added after armor.
goo.ability.param.freeze.thaw.descriptio: Share of a full frozen gauge that thaws each tick, from 0 to 1.
goo.ability.param.freeze.vulnerability.d: Extra share of a physical hit a fully frozen mob takes, from 0 to 1, so 0.5 deals half again as much.
goo.ability.param.freeze_blocks.radius.d: Blocks around the frost's center within which still water turns to ice, lava turns to obsidian and fire goes out.
goo.ability.param.fuse_books.pitch.descr: Pitch of the sound played when you carry no matching pair of enchanted books, 1 for normal pitch.
goo.ability.param.fuse_books.volume.desc: Volume of the sound played when you carry no matching pair of enchanted books, 1 for full volume.
goo.ability.param.glacial.radius.descrip: Blocks around the prism within which frozen mobs never thaw, water and lava stay frozen and fire goes out.
Most extra health, in half-hearts, that healing past full can bank.
goo.ability.param.gluttony.max_overhunge: Most extra food points, each half a drumstick, that eating past full can bank.
goo.ability.param.grab.far.description: Blocks from your eyes a held creature hangs while you look level or upward.
goo.ability.param.grab.near.description: Blocks from your eyes a held creature hangs when you look fully down.
goo.ability.param.grab.pull_speed.descri: Blocks per tick a grabbed item flies toward you.
goo.ability.param.grab.range.description: Blocks the grab reaches to catch a mob or item, before Telekinesis adds its reach.
goo.ability.param.grab.throw_speed.descr: Blocks per tick a left click throws the held creature at.
goo.ability.param.hasten_regrow.ticks.de: Extra ticks the shield hearts' regrow timer runs ahead for each tick the stream is held.
goo.ability.param.heal.amount.descriptio: Half-hearts healed on each living thing the stream reaches, every tick it is held.
goo.ability.param.heart_overlay.damage_t: Share of a physical hit the shield hearts take, from 0 to 1, so lower makes them last longer.
goo.ability.param.heater.burn_seconds.de: Seconds each burn keeps a mob on fire.
goo.ability.param.heater.cone.descriptio: Width of the heater's spray of fire, in degrees.
goo.ability.param.heater.damage.descript: Fire damage each burn deals, in half-hearts.
goo.ability.param.heater.every.descripti: Ticks of flaming between each burn.
goo.ability.param.heater.radius.descript: Blocks from the prism within which the heater finds a mob and pours its fire.
goo.ability.param.ignite.seconds.descrip: Seconds the struck target stays on fire.
goo.ability.param.leech.fraction.descrip: Share of the health the strike takes that heals you, from 0 to 1.
goo.ability.param.lifetap.fraction.descr: Share of the damage you deal that heals you, from 0 to 1.
goo.ability.param.lift.cap.description: Tallest the lift shaft runs above the prism, in blocks.
goo.ability.param.lift.rise.description: Blocks per tick the shaft carries a rider upward.
goo.ability.param.lift.sink.description: Blocks per tick a sneaking rider sinks down the shaft.
goo.ability.param.meteor.fall_ticks.desc: Ticks the meteor takes to fall from the sky to the landing spot.
goo.ability.param.meteor.power.descripti: Power of the explosion at the landing, where TNT is 4.
goo.ability.param.node_percent.node_perc: Percent of the full price a Blink to an Oculus costs, 100 for the full price.
goo.ability.param.nova.amount.descriptio: Half-hearts of frost the ring adds to each mob's frozen gauge before a crowd thins it.
goo.ability.param.nova.crowd.description: How much each extra mob in the ring thins every mob's freeze, 0 for no thinning.
goo.ability.param.nova.damage.descriptio: Freeze damage the ring deals each living thing it reaches, in half-hearts.
goo.ability.param.nova.hold.description: Ticks a full frozen gauge holds before it starts to thaw.
goo.ability.param.nova.physical_bonus.de: Flat damage in half-hearts a physical hit gains on a frozen mob, added after armor.
goo.ability.param.nova.push.description: Strength of the knockback pushing each creature away from the ring's center.
goo.ability.param.nova.radius.descriptio: Blocks the frost ring reaches from its center.
goo.ability.param.nova.thaw.description: Share of a full frozen gauge that thaws each tick, from 0 to 1.
goo.ability.param.nova.vulnerability.des: Extra share of a physical hit a fully frozen mob takes, from 0 to 1, so 0.5 deals half again as much.
goo.ability.param.order.order.descriptio: Place of this ability in its goo type's list among abilities with the same badge, lowest first.
goo.ability.param.particles.count.descri: How many particles each burst spawns.
goo.ability.param.particles.lift.descrip: Blocks above the anchor point the burst is centered.
goo.ability.param.particles.speed.descri: How fast each particle flies off as it spawns.
goo.ability.param.particles.spread.descr: Blocks the particles scatter from the burst's center on every axis.
goo.ability.param.petrify.fill.descripti: Points the petrify gauge fills each tick the fog holds a mob, out of 100; a full gauge turns the mob into a statue.
goo.ability.param.phase.duration.descrip: Ticks the target stays out of phase.
goo.ability.param.phase_blocks.depth.des: Blocks the hole tunnels inward from the struck block.
Ticks before each block of the hole steps back into place.
goo.ability.param.phase_blocks.radius.de: Blocks the square hole reaches out from its center line, so 1 makes it three blocks across.
goo.ability.param.phased.radius.descript: Radius in blocks of the sphere drawn while the stages run, read each tick.
goo.ability.param.phased.ticks.descripti: Ticks one stage lasts before the next stage begins.
goo.ability.param.pneuma.immunity.descri: Ticks the target needs no air after each held tick.
goo.ability.param.pneuma.refill.descript: Ticks of breath each held tick adds to the target's air.
goo.ability.param.pneuma.reserve_cap.des: Most extra air, in ticks of breath, that banks past a full air meter.
goo.ability.param.potion.amplifier.descr: Levels the effect stands above its first, so 0 is level I and 3 is level IV.
goo.ability.param.potion.duration.descri: Ticks the status effect lasts on the target.
goo.ability.param.pull.radius.descriptio: Blocks around the center within which creatures are pulled in.
goo.ability.param.pull.speed.description: Speed in blocks per tick each pull adds toward the center.
goo.ability.param.pulser_toggle.every.de: Held ticks between each toggle of the levers, buttons, doors, trapdoors and fence gates in the cone.
goo.ability.param.push.strength.descript: Speed in blocks per tick the push drives the target along the caster's look.
Ticks two linked creatures share their fate once the pair is made.
goo.ability.param.rally.damage.descripti: Damage in half-hearts a rallied mob deals with each strike.
goo.ability.param.rally.duration.descrip: Ticks the rally lasts after the ability last reaches the mob.
goo.ability.param.rally.health.descripti: Fraction added to the rallied mob's max health, where 1 doubles it.
goo.ability.param.rally.speed.descriptio: Fraction added to the rallied mob's movement speed, where 1 doubles it.
goo.ability.param.ray.every.description: Ticks between the ray's hits while held; the first tick of the hold always hits.
goo.ability.param.ray.exponent.descripti: How steeply each mob's share of a prism's split hit thins as more mobs share it; each takes the raised hit divided by the mob count to this power.
goo.ability.param.ray.factor.description: Multiplier on a direct hit's strength before a prism splits it among the mobs it reaches.
goo.ability.param.ray.radius.description: Blocks from a struck prism within which its split beams reach mobs in clear line.
goo.ability.param.ray.range.description: Blocks the ray reaches from your eye.
goo.ability.param.reap.radius.descriptio: Blocks the harvesting breeze swells out to from where the blob strikes.
goo.ability.param.reap.swell_ticks.descr: Ticks the breeze takes to swell to its full radius.
goo.ability.param.reflector.every.descri: Ticks between each refresh of the reflector prism's light links.
goo.ability.param.regress.ticks.descript: Ticks each shrink takes, from adult to baby or from baby to spawn egg.
goo.ability.param.reserve_drain.cap.desc: Most reserve hearts that may bank behind your health bar.
goo.ability.param.reserve_drain.drain.de: Hearts each held tick drains from your health into the reserve.
goo.ability.param.reserve_drain.floor.de: Hearts of health the drain never takes you below.
goo.ability.param.reserve_drain.ratio.de: Reserve hearts banked for each heart drained.
goo.ability.param.root.duration.descript: Ticks the vines hold the target in place.
goo.ability.param.root.fire_factor.descr: Multiplier on fire damage the target takes while the vines hold it.
goo.ability.param.root.hits.description: Hits the vines take before they break.
goo.ability.param.root.thorns.descriptio: Damage in half-hearts the vines deal each time the target strains past their leash.
goo.ability.param.scry.fade.description: Blocks past its reach the ping keeps traveling while it fades.
goo.ability.param.scry.growth.descriptio: Blocks the ping's radius grows each tick of the hold.
goo.ability.param.scry.reach.description: Blocks the ping travels before it starts to fade; creatures it crosses within this reach are revealed.
goo.ability.param.self.every.description: Ticks of the hold between each play of the sound.
goo.ability.param.self.max_ticks.descrip: Ticks of holding a full charge takes.
goo.ability.param.self.pitch.description: Pitch each play of the sound centers on, where 1 is normal pitch.
goo.ability.param.self.pitch_spread.desc: How far each play's pitch strays either way from the sound pitch.
Ticks of holding that one payment of the cost covers.
goo.ability.param.self.volume.descriptio: Volume of each play of the sound, where 1 is normal volume.
goo.ability.param.shift.near.description: Blocks from a fungus block you must stand within to shift.
goo.ability.param.shift.range.descriptio: Blocks your aim reaches to find the fungus block you shift onto.
goo.ability.param.shifter.distance.descr: Blocks each hit you would take blinks you along your look instead.
goo.ability.param.sight.factor.descripti: Times farther Fungal Shift reaches while the sight lasts.
goo.ability.param.signal_wave.cone.descr: Degrees from the wave's center line to its edge, in the cone behind the struck block.
goo.ability.param.signal_wave.range.desc: Blocks the wave reaches past where the blob landed, toggling each lever, button, door, trapdoor and fence gate on the way.
goo.ability.param.sound.frame.descriptio: Ticks after the ability reaches this sound before it plays.
goo.ability.param.sound.pitch.descriptio: Pitch the sound plays at, where 1 is its normal pitch and higher is shriller.
goo.ability.param.sound.volume.descripti: Loudness of the sound, where 1 is its normal volume.
goo.ability.param.spawn_slime.size.descr: Size of the slime born where the blob lands, 1 being the smallest.
goo.ability.param.spore_host.duration.de: Ticks the spores last on the struck mob, and a death within that time bursts its corpse.
goo.ability.param.spore_host.radius.desc: Blocks the burst from a spored corpse reaches.
goo.ability.param.stream.cone.descriptio: Degrees from the stream's center line to its edge.
goo.ability.param.stream.every.descripti: Ticks of holding between each play of the stream's sound.
goo.ability.param.stream.pitch.descripti: Pitch the stream's sound plays around, where 1 is its normal pitch.
goo.ability.param.stream.pitch_spread.de: How far each play of the stream's sound strays from its pitch, either way, so the repeat never sounds mechanical.
goo.ability.param.stream.range.descripti: Blocks the stream reaches from you.
goo.ability.param.stream.ticks_per_charg: Ticks you can hold the stream for each time it pays its cost.
goo.ability.param.stream.volume.descript: Loudness of the stream's sound, where 1 is its normal volume.
goo.ability.param.stun.ticks.description: Ticks the struck mob stays stunned, dropping its target and standing idle.
goo.ability.param.telekinesis.reach.desc: Blocks added to how far you can reach blocks and entities while the effect lasts.
goo.ability.param.teleport.node_cone.des: Degrees off your look an oculus may stand and still catch the blink.
goo.ability.param.teleport.node_range.de: Blocks away an oculus may stand and still catch a blink along your look; 0 lets none catch it.
goo.ability.param.teleport.range.descrip: Blocks the teleport reaches: a blink travels up to this far along your look, and a random jump lands within a square this wide.
goo.ability.param.toxin.duration.descrip: Ticks the toxin lasts, refreshed by every hit.
goo.ability.param.toxin.max_amplitude.de: Highest strength repeated hits stack the toxin to.
goo.ability.param.toxin.share_per_second: Fraction of the target's max health, from 0 to 1, the toxin takes each second at its first strength.
goo.ability.param.transmute_slime.morph_: Ticks the goo takes to morph from the slime into the new mob.
goo.ability.param.traveling.swirl.descri: Radius in blocks of the swirling nova drawn around the blob in flight.
goo.ability.param.undead.sun_damage.desc: Half-hearts of damage direct daylight deals you each second while you are undead.
goo.ability.param.updraft.duration.descr: Ticks the column of wind stands.
goo.ability.param.updraft.height.descrip: Blocks the column of wind rises above the blob.
goo.ability.param.updraft.radius.descrip: Blocks from the column's center to its edge.
goo.ability.param.updraft.speed.descript: Blocks per tick the column carries entities upward.
goo.ability.param.upkeep.upkeep.descript: The mB the held effect drains each tick it stands.
goo.ability.param.verdant.crop_odds.desc: One pulse in this many gives a crop within reach a growth tick.
goo.ability.param.verdant.interval.descr: Ticks between the prism's greening pulses.
goo.ability.param.verdant.radius.descrip: Blocks from the prism the greening reaches.
goo.ability.param.verdant.swell_radius.d: Blocks the puff of breeze swells out to on each pulse.
goo.ability.param.verdant.swell_ticks.de: Ticks the puff of breeze takes to swell out.
goo.ability.param.verdant.tries.descript: Random blocks each pulse tries before it gives up greening.
goo.ability.param.void_pocket.lifetime.d: Ticks the gate and its mirror in the pocket stand before turning back into the blocks they covered.
goo.ability.param.wall_cost.wall_cost.de: The mB added to a blink's cost when it passes through a solid block.
goo.ability.param.watch.radius.descripti: Blocks around the blob it watches for an entity.
goo.ability.param.watch.until.descriptio: Blocks an entity must come within to end the watch and set off what follows.
goo.ability.param.wisps.count.descriptio: Air blocks the flood checks each tick for a dark spot to light.
goo.ability.param.wisps.growth.descripti: Blocks the flood's edge spreads each tick; 0 reaches the full radius at once.
goo.ability.param.wisps.life.description: Ticks each wisp lasts before it fades.
goo.ability.param.wisps.radius.descripti: Blocks from you a wisp may be placed.
goo.ability.param.wobble.duration.descri: Ticks the wobble lasts, its target's attacks dealing no damage and knocking back by that damage instead.
goo.ability.param.zone.radius.descriptio: Blocks a cursed mob may come near a player before it warps away.
goo.ability.param.zone.range.description: Full width in blocks of the random jump a cursed mob warps by.
goo.ability.param.outsider.cell_cost.des: Void goo in mB a platform cell costs at the room's center.
goo.ability.param.outsider.charge.descri: Ticks the channel must be held before it carries you into your pocket room.
goo.ability.param.outsider.distance_cost: Void goo in mB each block a cell stands from the room's center adds to its cost.
goo.ability.param.outsider.enter.descrip: Void goo in mB the trip into your pocket room costs.
goo.ability.param.outsider.ring_ticks.de: Ticks of holding the platform takes to grow each ring outward.
Void goo in mB the Pocket reserves for each slot its stored items fill.
